done.58:
An automated testing engine: each cycle takes one experiment from the
queue, runs a backtest with transaction costs, splits the data into several blocks
walk-forward, selects parameters only from past data, then evaluates out-of-sample results
against buy-and-hold BTC. Failures are recorded, not deleted.

This test asks: if the same parameter grid is swept over data without timing patterns, how good is the best result? p above 0,05 means the strategy's edge can be explained by parameter search.
